problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the early 1900s, many cities in the United States relied on horse-drawn streetcars for public transportation.
- Horse-drawn streetcars required large numbers of horses, which had to be fed, stabled, and replaced frequently.
- Horse waste on city streets created serious sanitation problems and contributed to the spread of disease.
- Electric streetcars, introduced in the late 1800s, could run for longer distances without needing rest.
- By 1902, electric streetcars had largely replaced horse-drawn ones in most major American cities.
- Electric streetcars allowed cities to expand transit lines farther from the city center at lower operating cost.

The student wants to explain why cities switched from horse-drawn streetcars to electric streetcars.
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the early 1900s, many cities in the United States relied on horse-drawn streetcars for public transportation.
- Horse-drawn streetcars required large numbers of horses, which had to be fed, stabled, and replaced frequently.
- Horse waste on city streets created serious sanitation problems and contributed to the spread of disease.
- Electric streetcars, introduced in the late 1800s, could run for longer distances without needing rest.
- By 1902, electric streetcars had largely replaced horse-drawn ones in most major American cities.
- Electric streetcars allowed cities to expand transit lines farther from the city center at lower operating cost.

The student wants to explain why cities switched from horse-drawn streetcars to electric streetcars.
problem.question: The student wants to explain why cities switched from horse-drawn streetcars to electric streetcars. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Because horse-drawn streetcars caused sanitation problems and required constant care for large numbers of horses, cities adopted electric streetcars, which could run longer distances at lower cost.
By 1902, electric streetcars had largely replaced horse-drawn streetcars in most major American cities, changing the way people traveled within cities.
Horse-drawn streetcars required large numbers of horses, which had to be fed, stabled, and replaced frequently, making them costly for cities to maintain.
Electric streetcars allowed cities to expand transit lines farther from the city center at lower operating cost than had previously been possible.
problem.explanation: 학생의 목표는 도시들이 왜 말이 끄는 전차에서 전기 전차로 전환했는지 설명하는 것이므로, 말이 끄는 전차의 문제점(원인)과 전기 전차의 장점(결과)을 인과적으로 연결해야 한다. A는 위생 문제·관리 부담이라는 원인과 장거리 운행·저비용이라는 장점을 모두 제시해 전환 이유를 온전히 설명한다. B는 전환이 일어난 시점과 결과만 언급할 뿐 전환의 이유(원인과 장점의 대비)를 설명하지 않는다. C는 말이 끄는 전차의 문제점(하나의 note)만 다루고 전기 전차의 장점을 빠뜨려 전환 이유의 절반만 제시한다. D는 전기 전차의 장점(하나의 note)만 다루고 말이 끄는 전차의 문제점을 빠뜨려 전환 이유의 절반만 제시한다.
problem.evidenceTarget: notes 2, 3(말이 끄는 전차의 문제점)과 notes 4, 6(전기 전차의 장점)
problem.evidenceSpan: Horse waste on city streets created serious sanitation problems... Electric streetcars... could run for longer distances... at lower operating cost.
problem.answerRationale: A는 말이 끄는 전차의 위생·관리 문제(원인)와 전기 전차의 장거리·저비용 운행(결과)을 결합해 전환 이유를 인과적으로 설명하므로 목표를 달성한다.

difficultyReasons: 추론 단계는 1단계로, 원인(말 전차의 문제)과 결과(전기 전차 채택)를 모두 포함하는 선택지를 고르면 됨
오답들은 각각 원인 또는 결과 중 하나만 다루어 정답과 공유하는 정보가 부분적임
자료 해석은 단순 나열된 노트 내용을 종합하는 수준으로 복잡하지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 연대와 광범위한 변화를 언급하여 관련성 있어 보임
distractors.matches: By 1902, electric streetcars had largely replaced horse-drawn streetcars in most major American cities
distractors.whyWrong: 단순히 교체가 일어났다는 사실만 서술할 뿐 왜 교체가 일어났는지 이유(원인)를 설명하지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 말이 많은 말들의 유지 비용 문제를 언급하여 전환 이유의 일부처럼 보임
distractors.matches: Horse-drawn streetcars required large numbers of horses, which had to be fed, stabled, and replaced frequently
distractors.whyWrong: 말이 끄는 전차의 문제점만 서술하고 전기 전차로 전환했다는 내용이나 그 이점을 언급하지 않아 '전환 이유'라는 목표를 완전히 달성하지 못함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 전기 전차의 장점을 서술하여 전환 이유처럼 보임
distractors.matches: Electric streetcars allowed cities to expand transit lines farther from the city center at lower operating cost
distractors.whyWrong: 전기 전차의 장점만 서술하고 말이 끄는 전차의 문제점(대조되는 원인)을 언급하지 않아 전환의 이유를 완전하게 설명하지 못함
